Configure the compute environment for pipeline jobs

Source: R/setup_glm_pipeline.R
setup_compute_environment.Rd

Configure the compute environment for pipeline jobs

Usage

setup_compute_environment(gpa, preselect_action = NULL)

Arguments

gpa

a glm_pipeline_arguments object

preselect_action

optional menu action to apply without prompting.

Value

a modified gpa object containing settings for the compute environment

Details

Set shell initialization commands in gpa$parallel$compute_environment. Use global for commands shared by all jobs and the fsl, afni, or spm entry for commands specific to an engine. For SPM, make the configured MATLAB-compatible executable available here and set the SPM installation path in gpa$glm_settings$spm$spm_path.
